sections.text: The scene opens on a white work surface with a blue bin labeled 'Box 5' on the left and an instruction sheet in the center. Various tools, including screwdrivers and a wrench, are laid out near the top. A person's right hand, wearing a silver bracelet, reaches toward the tools. The left hand holds a black mechanical component with a silver faceplate in the lower-left area. The right hand moves over the tools, briefly hovering near a screwdriver before shifting focus. It then grasps a small, silver combination wrench lying horizontally. The hand lifts the wrench, rotates it slightly, and moves it toward the mechanical component held by the left hand. The right hand positions the wrench near the center of the component's faceplate, appearing to attempt an insertion or adjustment. The hand manipulates the wrench within the central opening of the component. After a moment, the right hand withdraws the wrench from the component and moves it back toward the tool area. The hand places the wrench back down on the table, near its original position. The right hand then moves away from the tool area, leaving the wrench on the table.
